issues.detail: Hebrew 'עָרֵי הַמּֽוּעָדָה' means 'cities of refuge' (designated refuge cities), not '節期城' (festival cities). The word 'מוּעָדָה' here is from the root 'יעד' meaning 'appointed/designated' (refuge), not 'festival' (which would be 'מוֹעֵד' in a different sense). This changes the meaning for a Chinese reader.
